en: The image is a black-and-white portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a mesh netting covering his face and neck, typical of protective gear used by beekeepers or explorers in areas with insects such as mosquitoes. The background is plain and faded, which gives it an old-fashioned, possibly early 20th-century studio or travel postcard aesthetic. There is no visible printed text or caption on the front of the postcard.
